hints.title: Prefix Sum Lookup for Target Sum
hints.text: Record earliest prefix sum indices to identify all subarrays with sum equal to target.

hints.title: Track Minimum Subarray Length Ending at or Before i
hints.text: Let min_len[i] be the minimum length of any valid subarray ending at or before index i.

hints.title: Combine Two Non-Overlapping Subarrays
hints.text: When a valid subarray ending at i has length L and starts at start_idx, update answer with L + min_len[start_idx - 1].

hints.title: See the blueprint
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def minSumOfLengths(self, arr: list[int], target: int) -> int:
        n = len(arr)
        pref_map = {0: -1}
        cur_sum = 0
        min_len = [float("inf")] * n
        best = float("inf")
        ans = float("inf")
        for i, x in enumerate(arr):
            cur_sum += x
            pref_map[cur_sum] = i
            need = cur_sum - target
            if need in pref_map:
                start_idx = pref_map[need]
                l = i - start_idx
                if start_idx >= 0 and min_len[start_idx] != float("inf"):
                    ans = min(ans, l + min_len[start_idx])
                best = min(best, l)
            min_len[i] = best
        return ans if ans != float("inf") else -1
```

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Comparing all pairs of non-overlapping target subarrays takes quadratic O(K^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Maintaining rolling minimum length prefix array allows O(1) pair combination per valid subarray.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate records prefix sums and dynamic minimum length up to index i to minimize sum of lengths.
complexity.notes: Returns -1 if two non-overlapping subarrays cannot be found.
